# git: config: define merge.conflictStyle

Use `zdiff3` conflict markers. **Motivation:** less noise, more readable conflicts. Setting: `git config --global merge.conflictStyle zdiff3`, from Git 2.35 ([release highlights](https://github.blog/2022-01-24-highlights-from-git-2-35/)): like `diff3` it shows the merge base between the two sides, and additionally moves lines common to both sides out of the conflicted region, so the part to resolve is smaller.
